mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays depressed while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, fewer weekday trips are made near shopping corridors and discretionary retail visits stay below the prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining below -5 and RESIDENTIAL remaining above +5 for most weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in TRANSIT below its recent level signals fewer city-center trips; retail and recreation mobility then falls within the next one to two weeks as transit-linked visits disappear.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 5 points week-on-week and stays below -12
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after TRANSIT crosses below -12 and remains there.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while RETAIL_REC is weak, households are substituting toward essential trips and away from discretionary shopping, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays above +25 and does not fall materially from current levels.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS from negative toward near-zero values marks outdoor substitution and broader local movement, which precedes a modest increase in retail-and-recreation mobility over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 8 points from the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the week after PARKS posts an 8-point or larger weekly gain.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES collapses while TRANSIT does not fall as much, the gap indicates remote work rather than full shutdown, and retail mobility should recover within four weeks as daytime shopping shifts to neighborhood stores.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES drops below -20 while TRANSIT stays above -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week mean by week 4 after WORKPLACES falls below -20 with TRANSIT still above -15.

mechanism_narrative: During a stable spring regime, rising PARKS mobility and falling RESIDENTIAL time jointly indicate more outdoor and shopping activity, which should lift retail-and-recreation mobility within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its recent mean two weeks after PARKS rises and RESIDENTIAL falls in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both recover together, commute-linked foot traffic returns and retail visits rise over the following month; if either series stays weak, the effect does not materialize.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -10 and WORKPLACES rises above -15 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over 28 days after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES cross their recovery thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed rise in GROCERY_PHARM together with flat or falling RETAIL_REC indicates defensive, necessity-only travel patterns that suppress discretionary shopping and push RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 4 points while RETAIL_REC does not rise
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM posts a 4-point weekly rise without a concurrent retail rebound.
